17:

21: @import '@webtui/css/base.css';

23: 
24: Import additional utilities, components, and themes the CSS file
25: 
26: ```css
27: @layer base, utils, components;
28:

46: 
47: ## Scoping
48: 
49: Astro scopes styles to specific islands instead of globally

52:

<content>1: ---
2: layout: '@/layouts/Doc.astro'
3: title: Installation
4: order: 3
5: ---
6: 
7: This guide covers how to install WebTUI with CSS, ESM, and CDN imports
8: 
9: For framework-specific guides, check out the [Installation](/installation/nextjs) section
10: 
11: ## Installation
12: 
13: Install the base WebTUI package with your preferred package manager
14: 
15: ```bash
16: bun i @webtui/css
17: npm i @webtui/css
18: yarn add @webtui/css
19: pnpm install @webtui/css
20: ```
21: 
22: ## Using CSS
23: 
24: Define the order of layers in your global CSS file using the `@layer` at-rule [[MDN Reference]](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@layer)
25: 
26: Ensure you define the layer order **before** importing the base stylesheet
27: 
28: ```css
29: @layer base, utils, components;
30: 
31: @import '@webtui/css/base.css';
32: ```
33: 
34: Import the desired utilities, components, and themes **after** the base stylesheet
35: 
36: ```css
37: @layer base, utils, components;
38: 
39: @import '@webtui/css/base.css';
40: 
41: /* Utils */
42: @import '@webtui/css/utils/box.css';
43: 
44: /* Components */
45: @import '@webtui/css/components/button.css';
46: @import '@webtui/css/components/typography.css';
47: ```
48: 
49: If you aren't using a bundler, see [Using a CDN](#using-a-cdn) instead
50: 
51: ## Using ESM
52: 
53: Stylesheets can be imported via ESM if your bundler supports it
54: 
55: ```tsx
56: import '@webtui/css/components/button.css'
57: 
58: type Props = {
59:     /* ... */
60: }
61: 
62: export default function Button(props: Props) {
63:     return <button>{props.children}</button>
64: }
65: ```
66: 
67: Ensure you have previously defined the order of layers in your global CSS file
68: 
69: ## Using a CDN
70: 
71: If you aren't using a bundler, you can import the CSS files from a CDN like [JSDelivr](https://www.jsdelivr.com/)
72: 
73: ```html
74: <style>
75:     @layer base, utils, components;
76: 
77:     @import 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@webtui/css@0.0.5/dist/base.css';
78: 
79:     /* Utils */
80:     @import 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@webtui/css@0.0.5/dist/utils/box.css';
81: 
82:     /* Components */
83:     @import 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@webtui/css@0.0.5/dist/components/button.css';
84:     @import 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@webtui/css@0.0.5/dist/components/typography.css';
85: </style>
86: ```
87: 
88: Browse all the available CSS files on the [JSDelivr page](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@webtui/css/dist/)
89: 
90: ## Full Library Import
91: 
92: Individual css module imports are preferred in production to avoid importing unused CSS
93: 
94: For development, you can import the entire library
95: 
96: ### CSS
97: 
98: Import the library using the direct package name **after** defining the order of layers
99: 
100: ```html
101: <style>
102:     @import '@webtui/css';
103: </style>
104: ```
105: 
106: If you aren't using a bundler, see [CDN](#cdn)
107: 
108: ### ESM
109: 
110: Import the library using the direct package name
111: 
112: ```js
113: import '@webtui/css'
114: ```
115: 
116: ### CDN
117: 
118: Import the `/dist/full.css` path instead of the base path
119: 
120: ```html
121: <style>
122:     @import 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@webtui/css@0.0.5/dist/full.css';
123: </style>
124: ```
125: 
126: Optionally, you can use a `<link>` tag
127: 
128: ```html
129: <link
130:     rel="stylesheet"
131:     href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@webtui/css@0.0.5/dist/full.css" />
132: ```

(End of file - total 132 lines)

9: ## CSS Variables
10: 
11: `@webtui/css` ships with a set of CSS variables that control [font styles](#font-styles) and [background/foreground colors](#colors)
12: 
13: These can be customized with the CSS `:root` selector on the `base` layer
14: 
15: ```css
16: @layer base {
17:     :root {
18:         --font-size: 18px;
19:         --font-family: 'JetBrainsMono', monospace;
20:     }
21: }
22: ```
23: 
24: ### Font Styles
25: 
26: ```css
27: @layer base {
28:     :root {
29:         --font-size: 16px;
30:         --line-height: 1.3;
31:         /* Font weight for bold text */
32:         --font-weight-bold: 700;
33:         /* Font weight for regular text */
34:         --font-weight-normal: 400;
35:         --font-family: monospace;
36:     }
37: }
38: ```
39: 
40: ### Colors
41: 
42: The base theme consists of **four** background levels and **three** foreground levels
43: 
44: Additional color accents/variants can be added to components individually with CSS or by importing a [theme plugin](#theme-plugins)
45: 
46: ```css
47: @layer base {
48:     :root {
49:         /* Default background color */
50:         --background0: #fff;
51:         /* Background levels 1-3 */
52:         --background1: #ddd;
53:         --background2: #bbb;
54:         --background3: #999;
55: 
56:         /* Default foreground color */
57:         --foreground0: #000;
58:         /* Foreground levels 1-2 */
59:         --foreground1: #444;
60:         --foreground2: #888;

62:         /* Border colors for various components/utils */
63:         --box-border-color: var(--foreground0);
64:         --table-border-color: var(--foreground0);
65:         --separator-color: var(--foreground0);
66:     }
67: }
68: ```
